MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 1

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 1

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 7

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

14. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

15. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

18. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 8
   D. 5

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

20. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
